(async()=>{
  const wait = async predicate => { const end=Date.now()+70000; while(!predicate()){if(Date.now()>end)throw Error('Live check timed out');await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));} };
  await wait(()=>document.getElementById('connection').textContent.includes('Gemini'));
  // Generate an app-owned demo drawing, then use actual vision instead of the preset demo plan.
  drawDemo('compass');
  document.getElementById('interpret').click();
  await wait(()=>!document.getElementById('stop').disabled);
  await wait(()=>document.getElementById('stop').disabled);
  if(document.getElementById('status').classList.contains('error'))throw Error(document.getElementById('status').textContent);
  if(document.getElementById('execute').disabled)throw Error('Gemini returned an unclear or empty plan.');
  const recognized=document.getElementById('planTitle').textContent;
  document.getElementById('execute').click();
  await wait(()=>document.getElementById('planBadge').textContent==='REHEARSAL COMPLETE');
  return {provider:'gemini',liveApi:true,title:recognized,rehearsal:true,desktopMutated:false};
})()
